# Manifest reference

<!-- Generated by `aios docs reference`. Do not edit: change the code it is made from. -->

What each kind of manifest may say, in `spec`. Manifests are YAML or JSON, one or
several to a file, under an App's `manifests/` and `policies/` folders. The full JSON
Schemas are served at `/v1/schemas/manifests/<kind>`; point an editor at them for
completion.

## agent

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `description` | string |  |
| `runtime` (required) | Runtime |  |
| `capabilities` (required) | list of CapabilityDecl |  |
| `subscriptions` | list of string |  |
| `tools` | ToolAccess |  |
| `memory` | MemoryAccess |  |
| `model` | ModelRequirements |  |
| `limits` | Limits |  |
| `scaling` | Scaling |  |
| `isolation` | `inprocess` \| `process` \| `container` \| `sandbox` |  |

## app

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `description` | string |  |
| `entrypoints` (required) | list of any |  |
| `agents` | list of string |  |
| `workflows` | list of string |  |
| `tools` | list of ToolRef |  |
| `memory` | AppMemory |  |
| `permissions` | Permissions | What the App asks a tenant admin to consent to at install time (FR-APP-03). |
| `egress` | Egress | Where this App's tools may send data (FR-SEC-10). Without ``allow``, no App list applies. |
| `policies` | list of string |  |
| `modelPolicy` | string |  |
| `config` | AppConfig |  |
| `budgets` | AppBudgets |  |
| `evaluation` | AppEvaluation |  |
| `humans` | list of HumanCapability | Capabilities people provide |

## workflow

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `description` | string |  |
| `steps` (required) | list of any |  |
| `output` | string or null | What the run returns, e.g. ${draft.output} (default: the last step's output) |
| `budget` | WorkflowBudget |  |

## policy

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `description` | string |  |
| `subject` (required) | PolicySubject | Whom the policy is about: exactly one agent, app, role or user. |
| `allow` | list of PolicyRule |  |
| `deny` | list of PolicyRule |  |
| `requireApproval` | list of ApprovalRule |  |
| `taint` | TaintRules | FR-SEC-09's "configurable per policy": where an App accepts the risk, and says so. |

## model-policy

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `rules` | list of ModelRule |  |
| `default` (required) | ModelDefault |  |
| `fallback` | `next-candidate` \| `none` |  |
| `retries` | ModelRetries |  |
| `budgets` | ModelBudgets | Each limit is hard. The soft limit is ``softAt`` of it (FR-MOD-08). |

## evaluation

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `app` | string or null | The App; given on the command otherwise |
| `cases` (required) | list of EvalCase |  |
| `graders` | list of any |  |
| `retrieval` | RetrievalEval or null |  |
| `gate` | EvalGate | When an experiment blocks: CI fails and a deploy stops (FR-OBS-07). |
| `timeout` | string or null | Per case; 10 minutes if not set |
